Used only to read local workbook data in an isolated Web Worker. SheetJS HTML
rendering, formula execution, macros, and external-link retrieval are not used.
Check https://cdn.sheetjs.com/advisories/ and the official release page before
upgrading. Re-run workbook-import-check.mjs and workbook-import-browser.mjs.
